amendments.reason: Original c2 check text 'grep -qv .' on empty git-diff stdin returns exit 1 unconditionally (no lines read, so -v matches nothing) -- a check that cannot fail is indistinguishable from one that passed, and this one couldn't pass even when the world was healthy. Fixed to a direct negated non-empty-diff test.
